title: Personal Credit Cards: closing a card and what survives the closure
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: closure basis

This policy covers the closing of a Personal Credit Cards account at the cardholder's decision and what follows from it: the balance, automatic payment, rewards points, the annual fee, a secured card's deposit, a credit balance, and reopening.

## Policy clauses in force

1. Closing a card is the cardholder's own decision.
2. A balance does not prevent closure; it remains payable under the existing terms and minimum payments, and autopay continues until the balance reaches zero.
3. Unredeemed points are forfeited at closure.
4. An annual fee billed within the annual fee refund window is reversed as the annual fee rules provide.
5. A secured card's deposit is returned once the balance is paid in full.
6. A credit balance on a closed account is refunded by official check or to a PCB account of the customer.
7. A closed account cannot be reopened; the customer applies again instead.

## Retired clause

The former clause under which the agent registers a separate account-closure request awaiting the cardholder's confirmation, with the account closing only after the cardholder confirms that request, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for confirming a card closure.

## What stays after closure

| Item | After the card closes |
|---|---|
| Balance owed | remains payable under the existing terms and minimum payments |
| Autopay | continues until the balance reaches zero |
| Unredeemed points | forfeited |
| Secured card deposit | returned once the balance is paid in full |
| Credit balance | refunded by official check or to a PCB account of the customer |
| The account itself | cannot be reopened |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Must a cardholder pay off the balance before closing?**
A: No. A balance does not prevent closure; it stays payable under the existing terms.

**Q: Can a closed card be reactivated later?**
A: No. The customer applies again instead.

**Q: What happens to points still on the card at closure?**
A: They are forfeited at closure.
